name: Doris Gillian Herring
bio: John Fothergill's first wife, whom he met at the Slade School in 1905-06 and married shortly afterwards. Fothergill never once named her - not in his memoirs, not in any surviving letter - and what little is recorded of the marriage comes through Romaine Brooks, who had just finished painting his portrait. After the separation she went to Rome and worked there as an artist until her death in the 1950s.
bio_note: No dates are recoverable from the sources read: Sox gives no birth or death year, no wedding date and no place, and Wikipedia's article on Fothergill does not mention her or the first marriage at all. The marriage year 'c. 1905-06' is Sox's own relative dating (Romaine Brooks places it just after finishing the 1905 portrait) and is not a documented date; a GRO marriage-index search would fix it. That Fothergill never named her is Sox's explicit point and is recorded here as part of the record rather than as a gap in it.
